title: Isolation of Treg cells and Treg cell suppression/death assay
protocol: Harvest 5 spleens from 5 to 12 week old mice.
Mash the spleens and pass the cells through a nylon strainer in medium.
Incubate single cell suspensions with FITC-conjugated anti-CD4 and biotin-conjugated anti-CD25 for 30 minutes on ice.
Wash the cells in 40ml of PBS/BSA.
Resuspend the cells in 2ml of PBS/BSA.
Incubate resuspended cells with 120 μl of anti-FITC microbeads for 15 minutes in the refrigerator.
Purify CD4+ T cells by magnetic isolation using the Auto MACS sorter with POSSELD2 program.
Wash the purified CD4+ T cells with PBS/BSA.
Incubate the purified CD4+ T cell suspension with release reagent followed by depletion of cells bound to beads using DEPLETE program in the sorter.
Incubate 500 μl of purified CD4+ T cell suspension with 2.5 μl of α-biotin microbeads.
Separate the mixture using POSSELD2 on Auto MACS for isolation of CD4+CD25+ Tregs.

Culture CD4+CD25- responder T cells (Tresp) (3×10^4) in U-bottom 96-well plates with Tcon (CD4+CD25-) (3×10^4) or Treg (CD4+CD25+) in the presence of soluble 0.5-0.75 μg/ml α-CD3 and 2.5 - 4 μg/ml α-CD28 for 2-4 days.
Label Tresp cells with CFSE to distinguish them from Tcon or Treg cells in co-culture.
Use Treg or Tcon cells in the co-culture with responders directly (fresh) or after pre-activation with plate-bound α-CD3 (5 μg/ml) and recombinant IL-2 (100U/ml) for 2-3 days.
Measure proliferation of T cells by incorporation of 3H-thymidine for the last 6-16 h of culture or by CFSE dilution.
Measure death at 0 hr and after 1, 2, and 3 days.
Perform cell death analyses of CFSE+ responders based on forward scatter or Annexin V and propidium iodide staining.
